QuestInfo.name: The Last Lantern
QuestInfo.2: #b#p715##k heard her grandmother's last words. She lit a lantern at her campfire and held the Lantern Rite. She keeps the fire now, as a hearthkeeper.

0.0: Here is the charm. I wrapped it in a copy of the message, written out in plain words.
0.1: "My little ember. I did not get lost. I stayed so the ones we left behind would not be alone in the dark. I lit a lantern for every name, and I will light one more for myself when my time comes."
0.2: "Don't grieve for me too long. Keep a fire burning for whoever is still walking. That is all a hearthkeeper ever does."
0.3: ...Please take this to #b#p715##k. I think she has waited long enough.

yes.0: Thank you. Tell her the tomb is safe again, and every name can go back where it belongs.

no.0: I understand. It's not an easy thing to carry. I'll keep it here until you're ready.

1.0: You're back! Did #b#p712##k read the journal? Did he find out what happened to...
1.1: ...That's her charm. I'd know her mark anywhere.
1.2: She stayed so they wouldn't be alone. She wasn't lost at all. ...And all this time I've been keeping a fire without knowing that's what she asked of me.
1.3: Will you stay a moment? I'd like to hold the Lantern Rite here. One lantern, for #bElda#k.
1.4: ...There. Grandmother would have said a camp is as good as a hall, as long as the fire is warm. I'm a hearthkeeper now, and anyone who passes through will find a fire here.
1.5: Thank you, truly. Please, take something for the road.

item.0: You've come from #b#p712##k? ...Where's the charm? Did you leave it with him?

lost.0: You lost it? Thankfully, you left the charm on my desk, and I still had my notes.
lost.1: I've wrapped them up again. Please take them to #b#p715##k in #b#m010006022##k.
